results.title: Nepal yet to decide on one-year extension of MCC projects
results.content: Without more time, projects cannot be completed by the August 2028 deadline, says an MCA-Nepal official.

results.title: Minister shares his resolve to improve the state of Nepali sports
results.content: Amid sharp criticism over the 10th National Games, Sasmit Pokharel spells out strict reforms, regular Games and accountability for sports associations.

results.title: Embassy’s refusal stalls Supreme Court ruling on video testimony from abroad
results.content: A landmark ruling allowing accused persons overseas to testify remotely remains unimplemented after Nepali embassy in Australia says it has neither authority nor the facilities to enforce the court order.

results.title: Court remands former chief secretary Aryal for four days
results.content: Ek Narayan Aryal is being investigated over alleged fraud and organised crime linked to extra biomedical fees charged to Nepali workers seeking jobs in Malaysia.

results.title: Mahakali bridge opens, ending years of risky river crossings
results.content: Jointly inaugurated by Prime Ministers Balendra Shah and Narendra Modi, the bridge replaces risky cable and inner-tube crossings between Nepal and India.

results.title: Human Rights Watch urges Nepal to act against illegal moneylenders
results.content: The rights watchdog says Gulf conflict-related disruptions have left migrant workers unable to repay high-interest loans, exposing families to threats, violence, forced evictions and sexual exploitation.

results.title: 12 arrested over gambling at Birgunj casino
results.content: Nine were caught gambling at Fortune City Gaming Club, while three others were accused of allowing Nepali citizens to enter the casino and facilitating gambling.

results.title: After ex-ministers, ex-chief secretary arrested over Malaysia labour deal
results.content: A police investigation into an eight-year-old labour agreement between Nepal and Malaysia has halted the departure of Nepali workers for jobs in Malaysia. Thousands of workers have been unable to travel since October 1.

results.title: Who is responsible for Kathmandu’s evicted squatters?
results.content: Seven months after the bulldozers, the state has found time for eviction notices but not for dialysis, decent meals or land certificates.

results.title: How Delhi's grand diplomacy distracts us from the ongoing territorial occupation of Nepali land
results.content: Kalapani is not a “boundary issue.” It is our land under illegal occupation. Until we state this clearly, we will continue to be misled.

results.title: Nepal mourns citizen killed in Saudi attacks, urges restraint
results.content: The foreign ministry says one of three Nepalis injured in the recent attacks has recovered, while two remain under medical care.

results.title: Election Commission move puts Deuba faction’s convention in doubt
results.content: The Nepali Congress leadership plans action against elected representatives attending rival conventions, while Deuba’s faction says the party’s legitimacy remains contested before the Supreme Court.

results.title: Nepal’s hopes of tapping Dailekh’s gas recede as project stalls
results.content: Drilling has ended, but further testing and a new agreement with China are needed to establish whether the estimated 80.7 billion cubic metres of gas can be commercially produced.

results.title: Nepali HORECA delegation explores business opportunities in Switzerland
results.content: The 14-member delegation met Swiss tourism and hospitality industry representatives in Lugano and Zurich to explore partnerships, innovation and sustainable business practices.

results.title: Fonepay, Nabil Bank launch digital payment app for foreign visitors
results.content: The app lets foreign visitors load funds using international bank cards and pay at more than 2 million Fonepay QR merchant locations across Nepal.
